short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Why is my electricity bill so high?!
short_scenes.narration: Volt's electricity bill shocked him. How is it actually calculated?

short_scenes.title: Typical appliance power
short_scenes.narration: Every appliance has a power rating in watts. The AC alone uses more than everything else together.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Power is how fast energy is used, in watts. Leave it on for hours and the energy adds up. One thousand watts for one hour is one unit on your bill.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: A fifteen hundred watt AC running four hours uses six units a day. Now you can check your own bill.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Watch the full video: Ohm's law, power & energy!
short_scenes.narration: For the detailed explanation, watch the full video on our channel. It's part of our complete Network Theory course.
